summary: @reclaimhosting needs to write a 5 page book and sell it for $40 (heck I'll write it). In that book have an access code for a student shared hosting plan. This way I can have it in the bookstore and kids can use financial aid to cover the cost. Asking department to cover #DOO is going to get really hard in CT fiscal situation. #digped
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @reclaimhosting needs to write a 5 page book and sell it for $40 (heck I'll write it). In that book have an access code for a student shared hosting plan. This way I can have it in the bookstore and kids can use financial aid to cover the cost. Asking department to cover #DOO is going to get really hard in CT fiscal situation. #digped
